summary: Iran and US forces engaged in direct kinetic exchanges in the Persian Gulf, with IRGC ballistic missiles targeting US warships and CENTCOM destroying five Iranian oil tankers in retaliation. Iranian military assets are on high alert, including IRIAF 8th AFB in Isfahan and a reported missile launch from Zanjan province. Simultaneously, IDF operations in Gaza degraded Hamas and Islamic Jihad capabilities by destroying three weapons warehouses and a rocket launch pit, while Israeli Navy leadership issued explicit warnings to Turkey and Houthis regarding maritime threats.
key_points: IRGC fired ballistic missiles at US warships twice in two days, prompting CENTCOM to destroy five IRGC oil tankers in Gulf of Oman and near Kharg Island. (Source: @VahidOnline/78286)
US Central Command confirmed destruction of five Iranian tankers after IRGC missile attacks on US naval vessels, with no US casualties reported. (Source: @New_security8200/203713)
Iranian military threatens large-scale missile attacks on US bases in the region if American forces target Iranian tankers at Kharg Island. (Source: @New_security8200/203706)
IRIAF 8th Air Force Base in Isfahan placed on high alert, and a missile launch was detected from Zanjan province. (Source: @shin_persian/9631, @shin_persian/9621)
IDF and Shin Bet destroyed three Hamas and Islamic Jihad weapons warehouses and a rocket launch pit across Gaza, seizing rockets and Kalashnikovs. (Source: @idf_telegram/25093)

Israeli Navy Chief Vice Adm. Eyal Harel warned Turkey and Iran-backed Houthis that Israel will act against any threat to its maritime freedom of action in Mediterranean and Red Seas. (Source: @manniefabian/59127)
Yemeni armed forces captured Qanaw military camp east of Al-Jawf from Saudi-backed mercenaries. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/390100)
Artillery shelling reported in Wadi al-Salouqi and a drone strike on Zibdin in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/41794, @redlinkleb/41799)

sections.executive_summary: Iran and US forces engaged in direct kinetic exchanges in the Persian Gulf, with IRGC ballistic missiles targeting US warships and CENTCOM destroying five Iranian oil tankers in retaliation. Iranian military assets are on high alert, including IRIAF 8th AFB in Isfahan and a reported missile launch from Zanjan province. Simultaneously, IDF operations in Gaza degraded Hamas and Islamic Jihad capabilities by destroying three weapons warehouses and a rocket launch pit, while Israeli Navy leadership issued explicit warnings to Turkey and Houthis regarding maritime threats.

points: Iranian Army Ground Force commander declared full readiness to confront any threat, stating even a one-percent threat constitutes a complete threat, as IRGC naval forces engaged US warships with ballistic missiles. (Source: @presstv/206064)
IRGC launched ballistic missiles at US warships on two consecutive days, with CENTCOM reporting the warships successfully evaded attacks and continued patrols. (Source: @VahidOnline/78286)

Following US destruction of five IRGC oil tankers (M/T Kaviz, M/T Charminar, M/T Horizon 1, M/T Riesco in Gulf of Oman, M/T Derya near Kharg Island), IRGC claimed retaliatory strikes on two US vessels and eight tankers, plus ten ships attempting Hormuz transit. (Source: @VahidOnline/78286, @VahidOnline/78291)
Iranian military issued explicit threat: any US attack on tankers at Kharg Island will trigger a large-scale missile offensive against American bases in the region. (Source: @New_security8200/203706)
IRIAF 8th Air Force Base in Isfahan placed on high alert; a missile launch was detected from Zanjan province, indicating heightened operational tempo. (Source: @shin_persian/9631, @shin_persian/9621)
An oil tanker was reportedly struck by an Iranian attack in the Persian Gulf near Dubai coast, per Iraqi media. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89909)

IDF and Shin Bet conducted targeted strikes across Gaza, destroying three weapons warehouses belonging to Hamas and Islamic Jihad containing dozens of rockets, Kalashnikov rifles, and combat equipment, plus a rocket launch pit used during the war. (Source: @idf_telegram/25093)
Israeli Air Force bombed a residential area in Al-Shati refugee camp west of Gaza City, per Press TV footage. (Source: @presstv/206061)

Israeli Navy Chief Vice Adm. Eyal Harel declared Israel will not tolerate threats to its maritime freedom of action by Turkey or Iran-backed Houthis, asserting the Navy can project power thousands of miles away. (Source: @manniefabian/59127)
Air defense intercepts observed over Israel were actually occurring in Jordanian airspace, triggered by Iranian missile fire, according to Israeli media. (Source: @amitsegal/64783)
IDF Division 80 completed a large-scale exercise in Eilat and the Arava involving missile boats, corvettes, and ground forces to enhance operational readiness. (Source: @idf_telegram/25100)
IDF and Shin Bet eliminated three weapons depots and a rocket launch pit across Gaza, with terrorists using stored Kalashnikovs for guard duties and control enforcement. (Source: @idf_telegram/25093)
Israeli airstrike hit Al-Shati refugee camp west of Gaza City, targeting a residential neighborhood. (Source: @presstv/206061)
Two Palestinians critically wounded in an Israeli drone strike on a motorcycle in Gaza City, per local reports. (Source: @yediotnews25/134847)
Artillery shelling reported in Wadi al-Salouqi area in southern Lebanon, with live map updates. (Source: @redlinkleb/41794)
Drone strike conducted on Zibdin in southern Lebanon, per live map. (Source: @redlinkleb/41799)
Iraqi media reported an oil tanker struck by Iranian attack in Persian Gulf near Dubai; separately, Iraq requested increased OPEC production quota. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89909, @naya_foriraq/89900)
UAE-backed mercenaries shelled Aboud camp with mortars in Yemen, with reports of Saudi-backed defense minister fleeing; not directly Syria/Iraq but regional. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89894)
All US forces in Jordan placed on high alert following Iranian missile attacks on US warships. (Source: @kianmeli1/91710)

CENTCOM destroyed five IRGC crude oil tankers in Gulf of Oman and near Kharg Island after IRGC ballistic missile attacks on US warships; crews evacuated before strikes. (Source: @VahidOnline/78286, @New_security8200/203713)
IRGC claimed successful attacks on two US vessels and eight tankers, plus ten ships in Hormuz Strait, causing heavy damage; unconfirmed independently. (Source: @VahidOnline/78291)
Iranian oil tanker reportedly hit in Persian Gulf near Dubai following Iranian missile activity. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89909)

key_developments: IRGC ballistic missile attacks on US warships (two days) triggered CENTCOM destruction of five IRGC tankers in Gulf of Oman and near Kharg Island, marking direct kinetic exchange. (Source: @VahidOnline/78286)

Iran threatens large-scale missile strikes on US regional bases if Kharg Island tankers targeted, while placing IRIAF 8th AFB Isfahan on high alert and launching from Zanjan. (Source: @New_security8200/203706, @shin_persian/9631, @shin_persian/9621)
US forces in Jordan on highest alert; intercepts over Israel attributed to Iranian fire engaged in Jordanian airspace. (Source: @kianmeli1/91710, @amitsegal/64783)

IDF/Shin Bet degraded Hamas/Islamic Jihad capabilities in Gaza: three weapons warehouses and a rocket launch pit destroyed, dozens of rockets and Kalashnikovs eliminated. (Source: @idf_telegram/25093)
Israeli Navy Chief warns Turkey and Houthis: Israel will act at any distance to protect maritime interests in Mediterranean and Red Seas. (Source: @manniefabian/59127)
Yemeni forces seize Qanaw camp in Al-Jawf from Saudi-backed mercenaries; UAE mercenaries shell Aboud camp, Saudi minister reportedly flees. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/390100, @naya_foriraq/89894)
Southern Lebanon sees artillery shelling in Wadi al-Salouqi and drone strike on Zibdin, indicating continued cross-border hostilities. (Source: @redlinkleb/41794, @redlinkleb/41799)
sections.threat_assessment: The direct Iran-US naval confrontation represents a significant escalation, with both sides demonstrating willingness to strike assets. Iran's explicit threat to target US bases if Kharg Island tankers are hit creates a dangerous tripwire. The simultaneous high alert status of Iranian air defenses and missile launches suggest preparation for further conflict. Israel's multi-front posture — Gaza operations, maritime warnings to Turkey/Houthis, and reliance on Jordanian air defense — indicates a coordinated but stretched deterrence framework. Yemeni advances against Saudi-backed forces add another dimension of proxy pressure.
sections.regional_response: US CENTCOM's rapid destruction of five IRGC tankers signals a calibrated but firm response to Iranian missile attacks, avoiding personnel casualties while degrading IRGC logistics. Jordan's elevation of US forces to highest alert reflects acute concern over spillover. Israel's public naval threat to distant actors (Turkey, Houthis) aims to establish deterrence by denial in maritime domains. Arab Gulf states remain publicly silent but the tanker strike near Dubai underscores vulnerability of energy infrastructure. Iraqi OPEC request amid tensions highlights economic pressures.
sections.intelligence_notes: The IRGC's claim of hitting two US vessels and eight tankers lacks independent verification and may be exaggerated for domestic consumption. The Zanjan launch and Isfahan airbase alert suggest Iranian missile forces are in a heightened launch-on-warning posture. The IDF's disclosure of Hamas using warehouse weapons for internal control indicates degraded command structure but persistent low-level capability. The Yemen camp capture and Saudi minister flight report, if confirmed, signals shifting ground dynamics. Lebanese border incidents remain limited but persistent.
